notes.title: Build 22 - Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you for the bug reports, this is the first patch to go live post-release and includes some minor fixes to some day 1 issues.


 Fixes freeze having an incorrect icon.
 Fixes swift cast having an incorrect icon.
 Fixes the finish mission button appearing when you start the next wave, even if you haven't completed the current objective.
 Fixes spell tooltips not correctly showing on hover.


I appreciate all of the support received so far, releasing a game is challenging so all the kind comments really help a lot! If you have the game, feel free to leave a review and let others know what you think of the game.

notes.title: Vespia: Shield of Aberration Release!
notes.notes:
Good news, after almost a year of hard work, Vespia: Shield of Aberration has finally released!

We hope you enjoy the game, and all of the new content we have been working on since the first prototype. The game is launching for $8.99 with a 20% discount, making now the perfect time to pick up the game.

Here are a few of the things that we have achieved over the past year:

New day progression system

New boss enemy

Multiple new enemy types

New abilities for the characters

A new card purchasing system

A new experience system for characters

Character upgrades

A huge number of new cards to unlock

New level types

An original soundtrack for the game, with different levels having different music

Dynamic audio that changes depending on the state of the game

Unlockable perks between each day

A new mission system

This is just some of the content that you will have access to with the full game, and for the low price it is more than worth picking up today (plus, you get to support an indie dev starting out, there are more great games to come in the future!)

Follow us for more, we can't wait for what the future holds!

notes.title: Progress Report 16 - Release Date & New Hardware
notes.notes:
Approaching The Release

We are now approaching the final stretches of development for Vespia: Shield of Aberration. It has taken longer than initially expected, but the game has grown and now has a unique identity that sets it apart from other games in the genre. Part of this growth means that the current state of the game is of a significantly higher quality than what is shown on the store-page and demo, so moving forward I will be taking down the demo and working to improve what is shown on the store page.

A lot of new content has made it into the game:

 Multiple full character skill trees.
 Multiple new end-game cards.
 A final boss.
 Tons of bug fixes.
 A whole new system for picking upgrades after you complete each day.


The game will be officially releasing on June 23rd. It will release just before the summer sale and will be participating in the sale with a launch discount. Make sure you wishlist so that you can get the game while it is on offer!

Hourglass Games Hardware

Up until now, the game has been developed on a laptop with a mere 8 GB of RAM. While this is great for ensuring that the game can run on even the lowest-end of hardware, this isn't great for developing games as compilation times are long and Unity is constantly crashing or complaining in one way or another. I've purchased a new computer which will significantly improve productivity, and allow for future updates and games to be of an even higher quality than what is offered in Vespia: Shield of Aberration.

Thanks for reading, happy hunting!

notes.title: Demo Update 13 - Minor Balance Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Build 13 has been released, bringing in some bug fixes for the demo as well as some new features:

* Balance: Freeze no longer stops enemies from moving, but reduces their movement speed by 50% (stacks).
* Tweak: Frozen enemies will now appear with a blue filter on their sprite.
* Tweak: Enemies will now prefer to avoid passing through placed characters.
* Fix: Various bug fixes from previous version.

notes.title: Demo Update 08 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I know it hasn't been long since the last update, but there have been some major/critical bugs that I've sorted out and it's better to push them sooner rather than later.

Changes:


 Fixes non 1920x1080 resolutions not working.
 Fixes spirits not being placable in an adjacent tile to another tower.
 Fixes lag caused by huge amounts of blood on higher waves.
 Fixes the background music suddenly ignoring volume settings and playing at full volume.
 Introduces new steam store-page artwork.
 Fixes spells placed on a tower getting stuck to the mouse for 250ms when releasing after dragging them.
 Towers can no longer be placed inside walls if you move them after being placed in a valid location.

notes.title: Demo Update 07 - Endless Mode, Upgrades, QOL Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've gotten a lot of requests for various features and QOL improvements, and I am pleased to announce that with build 7 these are making their way to the game. They are available to try immediately by downloading the demo. I hope you enjoy these changes, and if you do please wishlist the game!

Change List


 Spells placed on characters will now show their description on hover.
 Opening a character's UI will show the names of all spells that they cast on fire.
 Added endless mode.
 Added an endless mode shop, which allows upgrading various different stats.
 Added card packs to the shop, which can be used to unlock more cards.
 Nerfed the laser, it now starts with 4 base damage which reduces by 1 for each enemy it passes to until it reaches 1 damage.
 All projectiles will be consumed when impacting an enemy, even if the enemy dies before all projectiles have performed their hit code.
 Fixed the player not being able to see what wave they made it to.
